title: THE PROTON RUNG CERTIFIED IN LEAN: the T_X-ray field identity, its algebraic inverse M_impl, the (mu m_p) mass-ratio invariance, and the B06 50-object estimator numerics.
question: C04: (1) certify T = mu m_p sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B) from the virial (field identity); (2) certify M_impl = 4 (k_B T/(mu m_p))^2/(G a0) as the algebraic inverse (substitute T -> M and return); (3) certify the mass-ratio-invariance corollary under the (mu m_p) scale; (4) register the B06 estimator numerics on the 50-object sample (within-sample MAD ~ 0.05-0.08 dex).

theorems.name: field_identity
theorems.statement: k_B T = mu m_p sigma^2, sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0) => T = mu m_p sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B)

theorems.name: mass_free_ratio
theorems.statement: k_B T/(mu m_p) = sqrt(G M_b a0)/2 (the mass-free ratio the inverse inverts, G084)

theorems.name: inversion_identity
theorems.statement: M_impl(T(M)) = M with M_impl := 4 (k_B T/(mu m_p))^2/(G a0)
theorems.role: the algebraic inverse, T -> M round trip

theorems.name: ratio_scale_invariant
theorems.statement: k_B (lam T)/(lam (mu m_p)) = k_B T/(mu m_p)

theorems.name: mass_ratio_invariant
theorems.statement: M_impl(lam T, lam (mu m_p)) = M_impl(T, mu m_p)
theorems.role: the corollary: estimator reads only the mass-free ratio

theorems.name: proton_rung_ratio
theorems.statement: T_phase/T_bary = m/(mu m_p) at equal sigma
theorems.role: the corollary's rung face (G151 A3, c/a = 1.126e5)

V3_ratio_invariance_certified.statement: The law is mass-ratio-invariant under the (mu m_p) scale: M_impl depends only on k_B T/(mu m_p) and the rung reads only m/(mu m_p) -- rescalings of the baryonic rung drop out exactly.

statement: C04: THE PROTON RUNG CERTIFIED.  Lean (deepseek_push/lean/C04_proton_rung.lean, 7 theorems, exit 0, zero sorry, axioms {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}): (1) field_identity -- the virial k_B T = mu m_p sigma^2 with sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0) closes to the zero-parameter law T = mu m_p sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B); (2) inversion_identity + inversion_dual -- M_impl = 4 (k_B T/(mu m_p))^2/(G a0) is the algebraic inverse of the temperature law on the positive axis, both round trips; (3) mass_ratio_invariant + proton_rung_ratio -- the law reads only the mass-free ratio k_B T/(mu m_p) (and m/(mu m_p) at equal sigma, c/a = 1.126e5), so it is mass-ratio-invariant under the (mu m_p) scale.  Numerics (read-only reproductions of A02/B06/G075): the field identity at the horizon footing reproduces the 50 committed objects at worst rel err 0.0e+00; the inverse round trip returns M_b at 1.0e-15 rel on all 50; the mass-ratio invariance is exact (lam = 3/2); the 12 clusters imply ONE a0 = 9.36193e-11 (spread 9.0e-26); the B06 estimator on the 50-object sample sits at within-sample MAD 0.053 dex (per-sample X-COP 0.039, E11 0.040, HeCS 0.159; pooled 0.075) at the G109 0.062-dex benchmark, i.e. the 0.05-0.08-dex class, with the inverse estimator at 2x the T scatter (X-COP 0.077 dex).
